summary: Recent updates to the negotiation engine in Firefox have refined its handling of Real-Time Transport Protocol (RTP) tasks. Notably, RTP header extensions are now managed using a more efficient format, which enhances how data is handled during video and audio streaming. Additionally, the engine will now filter out redundant remote entries that conflict with our sending SSRCs (Synchronization Source Identifiers), optimizing media interactions. **These changes improve overall performance and reliability in multimedia communication, such as video calls, by ensuring that only unique and relevant data is processed**. Lastly, the Opus codec parameters like ptime, minptime, and maxptime are now properly parsed and utilized, which helps in optimizing audio quality and performance in different network conditions.
